_source: Outputs of the MIT-licensed reference implementation (the public code accompanying doi:10.1613/jair.1.19243, commit fe4e019be0b7100b23ea7e0d390d55d8ef8a4d72; src/dynnikov.hpp Dynnikov::add and src/braid.cpp Braid::reduce_fully), compiled with a 64-bit integer stand-in for GMP (overflow aborts) and driven by a small harness. Convention: generator i (1-based) = reference index i-1, sign + = reference sign true; coordinates interleaved (a1, b1, a2, b2, ...) for n strands + 1 puncture.
